invariant: ADR-0155 D-0, O2 (ruled A): on PostgreSQL the fixed-read leaf's inner read projects `record_id` cast to the BASE type of the outer key column (a domain resolved to the type under it, no typmod), read once per physical table from the catalog by `primeFixedReadLeafKeyTypes` before the synchronous compile, so an integer, uuid or character(n) key answers the rows today's id list answers and a malformed grant id fails the statement as a list member does. A text or varchar key takes no cast (step 3's statement). A table with no reading compiles as before: an integer or uuid key fails loudly (42883), a character(n) key misses a padded grant silently. Every door that compiles a `where` calls the prime beside its other catalog primes, so a door that skips it compiles an uncast subquery; each door is pinned as the first statement of a fresh driver.
